from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
import ast,collections,gzip,hashlib,json,platform,subprocess,sys
import numpy as np

import v23_finite_patch,verify_v23_finite,certify_v23_preservation,supplement_v23_checks
from certify_v23_preservation import outer_root_rows,bounds_for

ROOT=Path.cwd();TASK=ROOT/'debug/issue25/v23-finite'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def git(*args,cwd=ROOT):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=cwd)
pre=read('reports/nero-gripper-v23-preregistration.json');data=read('reports/nero-gripper-v23-finite-partition.json');report=read('reports/nero-gripper-v23-verification.json');supp=read('reports/nero-gripper-v23-supplement.json');pres=json.loads(gzip.decompress(Path('reports/nero-gripper-v23-preservation.json.gz').read_bytes()));rawtrace=gzip.decompress(Path('reports/nero-gripper-v23-split-trace.json.gz').read_bytes());trace=json.loads(rawtrace)
assert rawtrace==(TASK/'split-trace-original.json').read_bytes()
assert Path('reports/nero-gripper-v2-runtime-partition.json').read_bytes()==git('show','6eba4f3:reports/nero-gripper-v2-runtime-partition.json')
assert sha('reports/nero-gripper-v2-runtime-partition.json')==pre['baseline_file_sha256']
assert v23_finite_patch.geosha(data['entities'])==data['geometry_sha256']==report['candidate_geometry_sha256']==pres['candidate_geometry_sha256']==supp['candidate_geometry_sha256']
for path,h in pre['policy_sha256'].items():assert sha(path)==h

marker=read(TASK/'generation-started.json');assert marker['preregistration_sha256']==sha('reports/nero-gripper-v23-preregistration.json')
assert marker['timestamp_ns']>=int(git('show','-s','--format=%ct','1fc695f').decode())*1000000000
assert report['verifier_sha256']==sha('scripts/verify_v23_finite.py')
assert report['final_supplement_verifier_sha256']==sha('scripts/supplement_v23_checks.py')==supp['verifier_sha256']
assert pres['verifier_sha256']==sha('scripts/certify_v23_preservation.py')
for line in git('diff','e231e5b','--name-status').decode().splitlines():assert line.startswith('A\t'),line
old=read('reports/nero-gripper-v2-runtime-partition.json')['entities'];oldby={e['id']:e for e in old};newby={e['id']:e for e in data['entities']};unchanged=[]
for e in old:
 if e['id']in data['modified_baseline_entities']:continue
 n=newby[e['id']];assert json.dumps(e,separators=(',',':'))==json.dumps(n,separators=(',',':'))
 assert np.array(e['vertices_m']).tobytes()==np.array(n['vertices_m']).tobytes()
 assert np.array(e['faces']).tobytes()==np.array(n['faces']).tobytes();unchanged.append(e['id'])
assert len(unchanged)==314 and len(data['entities'])==1387 and set(data['modified_baseline_entities'])==v23_finite_patch.ALLOWED
assert len(newby)==1387 and data['candidate_generation_count']==1
for m in data['old_to_new']:
 assert all(eid in newby for eid in m['new'])
 if m['changed']:assert all(newby[eid]['baseline_entity']==m['old']for eid in m['new'])
for group,counts in report['fixed_regressions']['counts'].items():assert counts['PASS']==counts['total'],group
for row in report['fixed_regressions']['records']:
 assert row['distance_upper_mm']<=.01
 assert any(q['status']=='PASS'and q['saved_triangle_normal_deviation_deg']+1e-5<=.05 for q in row['saved_facet_confirmation'])
 assert all(q['outside10um_matching_ball']for q in row['unresolved_cell_bbox_exclusion'])
# Exact coordinate-span certificate is independent of the thin-cell LP and
# of support normals. A sphere cannot be wider than its containing bbox.
spans=[]
for e in data['entities']:
 v=[[F(float(x))*1000 for x in p]for p in e['vertices_m']]
 widths=[max(p[k]for p in v)-min(p[k]for p in v)for k in range(3)];k=min(range(3),key=lambda k:widths[k]);w=widths[k]
 spans.append({'entity':e['id'],'axis':k,'exact_width_mm':str(w),'width_mm':float(w),'scale_FAIL':w<F('0.1')})
minimum=min(spans,key=lambda q:F(q['exact_width_mm']));clear=next(q for q in spans if q['entity']=='V20157_FP028')
assert clear['scale_FAIL'] and clear['width_mm']<.014 and report['scale']['axis_width_certified_fail_count']==729

 v=np.array(newby[eid]['vertices_m'])*1000;lo0,hi0=v.min(0),v.max(0);seg=[];pts=[]
 for q in supp['protected_void_subchecks']['continuous_segments']:
  a,b=np.array(q['a_mm']),np.array(q['b_mm']);gap=np.maximum(np.maximum(lo0-np.maximum(a,b),np.minimum(a,b)-hi0),0);seg.append(float(np.linalg.norm(gap)))
 for q in supp['protected_void_subchecks']['mount_witnesses']:
  point=np.array(q['point_mm']);pts.append(float(np.linalg.norm(np.maximum(np.maximum(lo0-point,point-hi0),0))))
 assert min(seg)>.01 and min(pts)>.01
 void_exclusions.append({'entity':eid,'minimum_segment_bbox_separation_mm':min(seg),'minimum_mount_probe_bbox_separation_mm':min(pts),'scope':'The uncertain cell cannot affect these34 paths or131 point probes; this does not certify complete void walls/contours.'})

  assert all(tuple(q)in possible for q in cover['vertices_mm'])
  vertices=[[F(float(x))for x in q]for q in cover['vertices_mm']];supports=[list(map(F,row))for row in cover['exact_support_rows']]
  assert all(sum(row[k]*q[k]for k in range(3))+row[3]<=0 for row in supports for q in vertices)

   for a,b in zip(face,face[1:]+face[:1]):edges[tuple(sorted((a,b)))]+=1
  assert set(edges.values())=={2}
 for obligation in rr['terminal_material_obligations']:
  node=tr['nodes'][obligation['node']];region=outer+node['region_halfspaces_mm'][base_count:]
  if obligation['status']=='PASS_CONTINUOUS_SAVED_CONVEX_COVER':
   for proof in obligation['cover']['facet_dual_certificates']:
    actual_supports=rr['expanded_cover_geometry_certificates'][obligation['cover']['entity']]['exact_support_rows']
    assert proof['exact_objective_row']in actual_supports
    target=list(map(F,proof['exact_objective_row']));ids=proof['constraint_ids'];weights=list(map(F,proof['nonnegative_dual_weights']));assert all(w>=0 for w in weights)
    residual=[target[k]-sum(w*F(float(region[i][k]))for w,i in zip(weights,ids))for k in range(3)]
    upper=target[3]-sum(w*F(float(region[i][3]))for w,i in zip(weights,ids))+sum(max(q*F(float(l)),q*F(float(h)))for q,l,h in zip(residual,lo,hi))
    assert upper==F(proof['exact_upper_bound'])and upper<=0;dual_count+=1
  elif obligation['status']=='PASS_EXACT_INFEASIBLE':
   proof=obligation['certificate'];ids=proof['constraint_ids'];weights=list(map(F,proof['nonnegative_dual_weights']));assert all(w>=0 for w in weights)
   residual=[sum(w*F(float(region[i][k]))for w,i in zip(weights,ids))for k in range(3)]
   lower=sum(w*F(float(region[i][3]))for w,i in zip(weights,ids))+sum(min(q*F(float(l)),q*F(float(h)))for q,l,h in zip(residual,lo,hi))
   assert lower==F(proof['exact_positive_contradiction_lower_bound'])and lower>0;infeasible_count+=1
 for leaf in rr['discarded_leaf_prism_certificates']:
  p=next(p for p in pre['influence_prisms']if p['id']==leaf['prism']);node=tr['nodes'][leaf['node']]
  assert all(q in node['region_halfspaces_mm']for q in p['influence_halfspaces_mm']);discard_count+=1
 for e in rr['new_material_subset_certificates']:
  for cert in e['certificates']:
   weights=list(map(F,cert['exact_positive_weights']));assert sum(weights)==1 and all(w>=0 for w in weights)
   ids=cert['old_vertex_indices'];v=np.array(root['vertices_m'])*1000;point=cert['point_mm']
   delta=[F(float(point[k]))-sum(w*F(float(v[i,k]))for w,i in zip(weights,ids))for k in range(3)]
   upper=float(np.linalg.norm(list(map(float,delta))))+1e-12
   assert abs(upper-cert['distance_upper_mm'])<1e-15 and upper<=1e-7/4;subset_vertex_count+=1
